name: gdrive_search_files
description: Search files and folders whose name or text contains a search text, newest first.

query.description: Text to look for in file names and contents.

folder_id.description: Only search directly inside this folder; omit to search everywhere.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for id, name and kind; "detailed" adds modified time, size, parent folder and link.

name: gdrive_get_file_metadata
description: Get the metadata of one file or folder by id: name, kind, parent folder and modified time.

file_id.description: File id from a search or folder listing.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for the essentials; "detailed" adds MIME type, created time, size, description and link.

name: gdrive_read_file_content
description: Read the text of a Google Doc, Sheet (as CSV), Slides deck or plain text file.

file_id.description: File id from a search or folder listing.

max_chars.description: Return at most this many characters (100-50000); longer texts are cut.

name: gdrive_list_folder
description: List the files and folders directly inside a folder, folders first.

folder_id.description: Folder id from a search or listing; "root" (default) for My Drive.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for id, name and kind; "detailed" adds modified time, size, parent folder and link.

name: gdrive_create_document
description: Create a new Google Doc with the given plain text as its content.

content.description: Document text in plain text; line breaks are kept.

folder_id.description: Folder to create the document in; omit for My Drive.

name: github_search_issues
description: Search issues across GitHub with GitHub search syntax and return matching issues. Only issues are returned unless the query contains is:pr.

query.description: GitHub search query, e.g. "repo:octocat/hello-world is:open label:bug crash".

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for number, title, state and labels; "detailed" adds author, comment count, timestamps and URL.

name: github_get_issue
description: Get one issue (or pull request) by number, including its body.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for the issue itself; "detailed" adds author, timestamps, milestone and the first comments.

name: github_create_issue
description: Create a new issue in a repository.

name: github_add_issue_comment
description: Add a comment to an issue or pull request.

name: github_list_pull_requests
description: List pull requests of a repository, most recently updated first.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) or "detailed" (adds creation time, labels and URL).

name: github_get_file_contents
description: Read a file from a repository, or list a directory.

path.description: Path inside the repository, e.g. "src/main.py"; empty for the root directory.

ref.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA; omit for the default branch.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) returns up to 4,000 characters; "detailed" up to 40,000 plus size, SHA and URL.

name: jira_search_issues
description: Search for issues using JQL (enhanced search).

jql.description: JQL query, e.g. 'project = BENCH AND status = "In Progress"'.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for key, summary, status and type; "detailed" adds priority, assignee, labels, last update and URL.

name: jira_get_issue
description: Get an issue by key, including its description.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for the issue itself; "detailed" adds reporter, timestamps, URL and the comments.

name: jira_create_issue
description: Create an issue in a project.

name: jira_add_comment
description: Add a comment to an issue.

name: jira_transition_issue
description: Move an issue to another workflow status.

name: slack_list_channels
description: List the workspace's public channels with their ids. is_member tells whether the app can read and post in a channel.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for id, name and is_member; "detailed" adds topic, purpose and member count.

name: slack_read_channel_history
description: Read the top-level messages of a channel, newest first. Thread replies are not included; messages with reply_count have a thread you can read with slack_read_thread.

channel_id.description: Channel id from slack_list_channels, e.g. "C0123456789" (not the name).

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get older messages; omit for the newest.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for ts, author, text and thread info; "detailed" adds the posting time.

name: slack_read_thread
description: Read a thread: the parent message followed by its replies, oldest first.

channel_id.description: Channel id of the thread, e.g. "C0123456789".

thread_ts.description: ts of the thread's parent message, from a history result.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call to get the next page; omit for page one.

response_format.description: "concise" (default) for ts, author, text; "detailed" adds the posting time.

name: slack_post_message
description: Post a new top-level message to a channel the app is a member of. To answer an existing message, use slack_reply_in_thread instead.

text.description: Message text (Slack mrkdwn, at most 4000 characters).

name: slack_reply_in_thread
description: Reply to a top-level message, in its thread.

channel_id.description: Channel id of the message, e.g. "C0123456789".

thread_ts.description: ts of the top-level message to reply to, from a history result.

text.description: Reply text (Slack mrkdwn, at most 4000 characters).
